topic: Parts and Functions of the Nervous System
key_concepts: The nervous system is the main control and message center of the body
Neurons are nerve cells that transmit electrical impulses and relay information
The central nervous system is made up of the brain and spinal cord
The peripheral nervous system is made up of neurons extending from the spinal cord to body
The nervous system enables voluntary movement, sensory detection, involuntary life functio
The brain is protected by the skull and governs most body functions
The brain receives, processes, stores, and sends information to direct body responses
The brain is the seat of human intelligence and enables decision-making, reasoning, learni
The adult human brain weighs about 2.5 to 3 pounds
The brain has wrinkled folds called gyri or convolutions and a brainstem
